method: whole-implementation inventory and risk-based component boundary review; not independent line-by-line audit

components.depth: entry-point, URL/digest/budget boundaries and existing negative controls
risk-based rendering/storage/worker boundary review; component and browser regression coverage
central parser/generator/cache/receipt/CI boundary review; deterministic contracts
inventory only; frozen execution evidence excluded from current runtime review

exclusions: Generated corpora and independently owned producer implementations
Vendor internals and frozen historical engine bytes (pins/adapters checked)
Historical validation code except retained regression controls
Lines outside selected source/control-flow paths; inventory membership is not a claim of exhaustive inspection
Live providers, model calls, current hosted-service or AI-client/Voice acceptance
Domain/legal correctness, restricted-data deployment and human assistive-technology acceptance
